Internal reference: DESIGN-00178.
Owner: bob@example.internal.
Created on: 2023-06-28.
Last updated: 2023-07-08.
Tags: engineering, architecture, technical-design.

The system is organized into several services connected through a message bus. Each service owns its own data storage and exposes a clear API. Requests from the user interface flow through an edge gateway, which handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to backend se

handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to backend services.

The data model is designed to support gradual evolution. Schemas use additive changes where possible, and deprecations are communicated before fields are removed. Migrations are tested in staging before production.

Each service publishes metrics for latency, error rate, and throughput. Dashboards aggregate these metrics to provide a high-level view, while detailed panels help engineers drill into specific components.

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The client caches stable configuration data, while the edge gateway caches frequently requested resources with short time-to-live values. Backend services maintain their own caches for expensive computations.

Owner: eve@example.internal.
Created on: 2025-05-24.
Last updated: 2025-06-11.
Tags: engineering, technical-design, architecture.

The data model is designed to support gradual evolution. Schemas use additive changes where possible, and deprecations are communicated before fields are removed. Migrations are tested in staging before production.

The system is organized into several services connected through

The system is organized into several services connected through a message bus. Each service owns its own data storage and exposes a clear API. Requests from the user interface flow through an edge gateway, which handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to backend services.

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The client caches stable configuration data, while the edge gateway caches frequently requested resources with short time-to-live values. Backend services maintain the

es with short time-to-live values. Backend services maintain their own caches for expensive computations.

Each service publishes metrics for latency, error rate, and throughput. Dashboards aggregate these metrics to provide a high-level view, while detailed panels help engineers drill into specific components.

impact was that some users experienced timeouts while loading dashboards. The response included rolling back a configuration change and adding temporary logging to narrow down the root cause.

Timeline: The first alert fired on the metrics dashboard, followed by customer reports in the support channel. Engineers conf

lowed by customer reports in the support channel. Engineers confirmed the issue, identified the suspect deployment, and coordinated a rollback while monitoring error rates and latency.

handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to backend services.

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The client caches stable configuration data, while the edge gateway caches frequently requested resources with short time-to-live values. Backend services maintain their own caches for expensive computations.

Each service publishes metrics for latency, error rate, and throughput. Dashboards aggregate these metrics to provide a high-level view, while detailed panels help engi

cs to provide a high-level view, while detailed panels help engineers drill into specific components.

The data model is designed to support gradual evolution. Schemas use additive changes where possible, and deprecations are communicated before fields are removed. Migrations are tested in staging before production.

drill into specific components.

The data model is designed to support gradual evolution. Schemas use additive changes where possible, and deprecations are communicated before fields are removed. Migrations are tested in staging before production.

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The

Caching is introduced at multiple layers to reduce latency. The client caches stable configuration data, while the edge gateway caches frequently requested resources with short time-to-live values. Backend services maintain their own caches for expensive computations.

The system is organized into several services connected through a message bus. Each service owns its own data storage and exposes a clear API. Requests from the user interface flow through an edge gateway, which handles authentication, rate
low through an edge gateway, which handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to backend services.

med the issue, identified the suspect deployment, and coordinated a rollback while monitoring error rates and latency.

Incident report summary: An elevated error rate was observed in the primary API during peak traffic. The immediate impact was that some users experienced timeouts while loading dashboards. The response included rolling back a configuration change and adding temporary logging to narrow down the root cause.

Post-incident review: The outage was traced to a misconfigured database connection p

: The outage was traced to a misconfigured database connection pool. The pool size was reduced during routine maintenance, which caused contention under normal peak load. The fix involved restoring appropriate pool parameters and adding a pre-deployment check.

Follow-up actions: Add automated checks for configuration drift, improve alert descriptions to reduce ambiguity, and document decision points from the incident to refine the response playbook.
